props.text: Born March 12, 1938, Dayton, Ohio  ·  Died June 3, 2024, Asheville, North Carolina

Eleanor Whitfield spent four decades teaching elementary music in Dayton public schools, where generations of students learned their first chords and harmonies from her. A lifelong gardener and avid reader, she was known for her warmth, her wit, and the Sunday pies she shared with neighbors. She is survived by her husband of 58 years, Robert; her children, Ann and Thomas; and five grandchildren who were the lights of her life. She moved to Asheville in 2015 to be closer to family and quickly found a new choir and a new garden to tend.
